meta.title: AI Supervision for Traversability Segmentation in Unstructured Environments
meta.subtitle: Interactive Research Visualizer & Comprehensive Benchmark Explorer
meta.author: Master's Thesis / UC3M (Universidad Carlos III de Madrid)

convergence.description: Best overall test accuracy and lowest False-Safe Rate. Balances high mIoU with efficient depthwise separable convolution features.
Symmetric U-Net architecture with strong boundary recovery and high precision traversability predictions.
Ultra-lightweight real-time FPN with inverted bottleneck residual blocks, delivering 147 FPS on H100 and low CPU overhead.
Lightweight transformer with multi-scale self-attention without positional encodings, yielding robust long-range context.
Compact encoder-decoder with MobileNetV2 features, highly responsive across varying terrain granularities.
Foundation model zero/few-shot approach using frozen Segment Anything ViT-S backbone. Strong features but significantly higher latency and parameter cost.
Real-time edge champion with proportional-integral-derivative boundary alignment. Achieves 1038 FPS forward pass on RTX 5060 with TensorRT.
Two-stream high-speed architecture separating spatial details from high-level semantics. Excellent speed on embedded CPUs.
Trained from scratch. Dual-stream resolution mechanism reaching 245 FPS on H100 and up to 36.5 FPS on compiled Ryzen CPU.

worst_false_safe.title: Severe False Safe in Hazard Depression
worst_false_safe.description: The model incorrectly classifies an untraversable trench/depression as traversable path, posing an acute rollover hazard.

worst_false_safe.title: False Safe on Dense Off-Road Brush
worst_false_safe.description: Vegetation clusters with irregular shadows misclassified as passable ground.

worst_false_safe.title: Overhanging Branch & Shadow Ambiguity
worst_false_safe.description: Sun glare through overhanging vegetation dilutes depth cues, causing boundary over-expansion.

worst_false_block.title: False Block on Path Dust & Texture Variation
worst_false_block.description: Sharp surface texture transition on perfectly flat gravel causes false obstacle prediction, triggering phantom braking.

worst_false_block.title: False Block in Tree Canopy Shadow
worst_false_block.description: Dense ground shadows from pine canopy cause false negative block classification.

worst_false_block.title: Transition False Block at Curve Entrance
worst_false_block.description: Unpaved track turns into light brush; model is over-conservative on the inside turn.

worst_boundary.title: Soft Trail Edge Boundary Ambiguity
worst_boundary.description: Gradual dirt-to-grass transition lacking sharp physical edges.

worst_boundary.title: Boundary Error on Undulating Grass Verge
worst_boundary.description: Irregular terrain fringe where ground truth boundary exhibits high local variance.

thesis_figures.title: Semantic Segmentation in Unstructured Off-Road Domains
thesis_figures.description: Formulation of binary traversability segmentation mapping RGB camera frames to pixel-level traversable/untraversable masks for path planning.

thesis_figures.title: Depthwise Separable Convolutions & Inverted Residuals
thesis_figures.description: Architectural principle enabling real-time lightweight backbones (MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B0) by factorizing spatial filtering and channel cross-projection.

thesis_figures.title: Frozen Foundation Model Transfer Learning (ROD / SAM)
thesis_figures.description: Visualisation of frozen EfficientSAM ViT-S encoder paired with a lightweight traversability decoder head for few-shot adaptation.

thesis_figures.title: CaT Dataset Hierarchy & Data Partitioning
thesis_figures.description: Hierarchical breakdown of the CaT off-road dataset into 1,002 train, 266 val, and 544 test samples across blue and green terrain classes.

thesis_figures.title: Pixel-Level Confusion Matrix & Asymmetric Error Space
thesis_figures.description: Definition of True Positives, True Negatives, False Safe (FP, collision hazard), and False Block (FN, unnecessary stop) over 133.7M pixel decisions.

thesis_figures.title: Edge Compute Frame Budget Allocation
thesis_figures.description: Breakdown of the 100 Hz / 30 Hz autonomous robot control loop, showing inference vs camera I/O, resizing, host-to-device, and planner overhead.

thesis_figures.title: Safety Evidence Ladder for Autonomous Vehicles
thesis_figures.description: Hierarchical validation framework linking offline benchmarks, multi-seed statistical significance, asymmetric safety bounds, and on-robot deployment.

thesis_figures.title: Convergence Suite Multi-Architecture Validation Curves
thesis_figures.description: Empirical validation curves over 300 epochs showing early stopping trigger points under patience 25.

thesis_figures.title: Convergence-Aware vs 15-Epoch Fixed Budget mIoU
thesis_figures.description: Paired bar comparison showing systematic accuracy gains unlocked by convergence scheduling across all 9 models.

thesis_figures.title: Selected Checkpoint Epoch Distribution
thesis_figures.description: Distribution of best-validation epochs across seeds 1337, 2027, and 4242, illustrating varying model convergence rates.
